items.headline: Council to hear appeal of Civic Center Drive townhome project
items.summary: The council is scheduled to hear an appeal of an approved architectural permit for a project at 860 and 858 Civic Center Drive and 1526 Alviso Street that would demolish existing buildings and build 14 townhomes and a duplex with commercial space.

items.headline: Public meeting on Oakmead Parkway housing project impacts
items.summary: The city held a public scoping meeting to gather input on the environmental review for a proposed residential project at 1250 Oakmead Parkway.
